**Direct answer:** Global semiconductor sales hit a record in 2024, passing $600 billion for the first time. The SIA's first figure, built from WSTS data, was $627.6 billion, up 19.1% from $526.8 billion in 2023. WSTS later revised the total to $630.5 billion. Gartner counts revenue on a different basis and put 2024 at $655.9 billion, up 21%. The numbers differ because the sources use different methods, so the source and vintage should always be named.

**How to tell a final annual figure from other numbers**
- A final annual figure is a realized full-year total from a named source. It is the latest revision, not the first release. For 2024, the SIA/WSTS total is $630.5 billion, and the first-release $627.6 billion is superseded.
- A forecast is a projection for a future period. The SIA's "double-digit growth projected for 2025" is a forecast, not a result.
- Regional growth rates apply to one region. Examples are the Americas at +44.8% and Europe at –8.1%. They are not the global total and should not be used as the global growth rate.
- Preliminary estimates are not final. Gartner's February 2025 estimate was $626 billion, up 18%, and its April 2025 final was $655.9 billion, up 21%.
- Growth rates depend on the base year. The 19.1% rate uses the original 2023 base of $526.8 billion. I did not find a recalculated rate for the revised $630.5 billion.

**Claims and sources**

Claim: SIA reported 2024 global sales of $627.6B, up 19.1% from $526.8B in 2023. This was a record and the first year above $600B.
- https://www.semiconductors.org/global-semiconductor-sales-increase-19-1-in-2024-double-digit-growth-projected-in-2025/
- https://x.com/SIAAmerica/status/1887958734183219214

Claim: The monthly data comes from WSTS, and the SIA page notes a March 3, 2025 revision of the 2024 total to $630.5B.
- https://www.semiconductors.org/global-semiconductor-sales-increase-19-1-in-2024-double-digit-growth-projected-in-2025/

Claim: SIA's 2025 report uses $630.5B as the 2024 base, with 2025 sales of $791.7B, up 25.6%. This came from a search summary only. The page fetch failed, so I haven't verified it directly.
- https://atreg.com/global-2025-semiconductor-sales-rise-by-25-6-percent-to-791-7-billion/

Claim: 2024 regional growth was Americas +44.8%, China +18.3%, Asia Pacific/All Others +12.5%, Japan –0.4%, Europe –8.1%.
- https://www.semiconductors.org/global-semiconductor-sales-increase-19-1-in-2024-double-digit-growth-projected-in-2025/

Claim: SIA described 2025 double-digit growth as a projection, which makes it a forecast.
- https://www.semiconductors.org/global-semiconductor-sales-increase-19-1-in-2024-double-digit-growth-projected-in-2025/

Claim: Gartner's final 2024 revenue was $655.9B, up 21%. Its February preliminary estimate was about $626B, up 18%.
- https://www.gartner.com/en/newsroom/press-releases/2025-04-10-gartner-says-worldwide-semiconductor-revenue-grew-21-percent-in-2024
- https://www.gartner.com/en/newsroom/press-releases/2025-02-03-gartner-says-worldwide-semiconductor-revenue-grew-18-percent-in-2024

**Limits of the evidence**
- I did not retrieve WSTS's own publication of the $630.5B figure. It is confirmed only through the SIA page.
- I did not find an explanation for the gap between Gartner and WSTS. It likely reflects different scope and methodology, but that is my inference, not something I found in a source.
